name: Aoyama Zaisan Networks Company,Limited
summary: Aoyama Zaisan Networks Company,Limited provides property consulting solutions to individual and institutional asset owners in Japan. It provides asset succession, business succession, and asset management services. The company offers property succession services, including consultation for pre- and post-inheritance, effective utilization of owned real estate, land utilization, and real estate purchase and sale. It also provides support services for determining successors, organizational restructuring, financial improvement, and growth strategy. The company was formerly known as Funai Zaisan Consultants Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Aoyama Zaisan Networks Company,Limited in July 2012. Aoyama Zaisan Networks Company,Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
